about: Round 4, after round 3: around (32, 2) neither a stronger port nor weaker damping helped either PHS model; s07 stays the only PHS configuration that learns task B. Both PHS models get the same last two probes around (32, 2): a lower lr and two sub-steps instead of four (half the cost). Control-GRU stops at 10 configurations (lr is its only setting and is settled at 7e-3). Control-GRU-pm learned task B but not task A at every lr up to 2e-2, so its next probes go higher, plus one lower. From this round on a diverged run keeps its best validation checkpoint (diverged_at_step) instead of being FAILED.

trials.rationale: lr above the grid so far (task A unlearned up to 2e-2)
